subject: Enhance Prot_Event_Closed with exception handling
body:
Enhance Prot_Event_Closed with exception handling

Added error logging for protocol close event under UI.window.ConnectionWindow.

triage.rationale: Blanket catch that swallows close errors. Our fork already guards this path (disposed checks, deferred QueueCloseTab NRE-guarded, 6c788ae45). Masking exceptions is a regression.
